summary: Payment refactor complete: gateway lama removed → BATPay (cash/piutang/online). Backend 100% (33/33 tests pass). Frontend verified: 3 payment methods, BATPay placeholder mode, admin flows, owner settings. All legacy endpoints return 404. Webhook with X-CALLBACK-TOKEN works correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/payments/config -> exactly 3 methods: cash, piutang, online
GET /api/payments/config -> online has 5 channels: qris, va_bca, va_mandiri, va_cimb, va_danamon
GET /api/admin/receivables -> piutang order appears in orders array
POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/settle -> marks piutang order as paid
GET /api/payments/{order}/status -> returns pending for online orders
POST /api/payments/{order}/create cash -> switches online to cash, removes service_fee
PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/payment-method: piutang->online qris -> status='pending', service_fee added
PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/payment-method: online->cash -> service_fee removed, total restored
POST /api/payments/batpay/webhook with X-CALLBACK-TOKEN + correct amount -> 200, responseCode='2005200', order paid+selesai
GET /api/admin/settings/payments with OWNER token -> mode='batpay_placeholder', enabled=false, fees.default.percent=0.7, channels present, webhook_url correct
Frontend: Admin orders page shows new payment method labels (Cash (Tunai), Bayar Nanti (Piutang), Bayar Online (BATPay))
Frontend: Admin dashboard displays piutang summary
Frontend: No COD/gateway lama text on customer pages
seed_data_creation: Created 10+ test orders via backend_test.py: cash, piutang, online (qris + va_bca), method change tests, webhook tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment refactor complete. BATPay in placeholder mode (credentials empty). Webhook uses X-CALLBACK-TOKEN: dev-webhook-token-semoyo. Admin can change payment method via PATCH /api/admin/orders/{id}/payment-method. Cash orders completed via POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/complete-cash. Service fee 0.7% gross-up for online payments. All legacy payment methods (COD, gateway lama, gateway lama) removed and return 422/404.
